theme.rationale: High-end B2B SaaS demands authority, clarity, and trust. Using stark contrasts with premium glassmorphic elements elevates the platform beyond generic job boards into a 'Figma-level' product. The dark/light toggle allows flexibility while maintaining a premium aesthetic.

layout.spacing_system: Generous (p-6, p-8, p-12) for breathing room, standard Tailwind units.
layout.border_radius: Rounded-lg (8px) for tech/professional feel, subtle and sharp.

grid_strategies.marketing: Asymmetric bento, overlapping elements, wide gaps (gap-12).
grid_strategies.dashboard: Tight bento grids (gap-4 or gap-6) for Admin and Employee portals.
grid_strategies.job_listings: List views with strong optical alignment, dense data grouping, clear borders.

components_strategy.buttons: Sharp inner contrasts, flat primary colors. No muddy gradients. Clear hover states with translation (translate-y-[-2px]).
components_strategy.cards: Subtle 1px borders (border-border), flat backgrounds. Hover states feature slight lift and shadow-lg.
components_strategy.nav_banner: Translucent glass nav banner including Logo, Technology, Jobs, Refer a Talent, Pricing, Contact, sun/moon toggle, and auth dropdown.
components_strategy.flowchart: Animated API workflow flowchart on the home page using Framer Motion or specialized node/SVG animation.
components_strategy.stacked_companies: Stacked cards layout (10 newly added companies) with logo, name, role, experience, location. Use vertical cascade styling.
components_strategy.logo_carousel: Right-to-left infinite scrolling animated logo carousel (10-20 companies).
components_strategy.forms: Minimalist fields, Shadcn UI inputs heavily customized, visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-primary).

animations.micro_interactions: Subtle scale on click, explicit hover state color shifts.
animations.page_transitions: Fade and slight upward translate on load via Framer Motion.
animations.complex: Live animated flowchart mimicking data scraping and delivery. Infinite scrolling logo marquee.

testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based (e.g., 'job-listing-card', 'apply-button', 'theme-toggle-btn'). All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for the home page marketing layouts, avoiding rigid Shadcn cards to ensure fluid overlap and asymmetry.
Implement Shadcn components heavily on the Admin Dashboard and User Referral Portals, using tight bento grids (gap-4/gap-6).
Nav Banner MUST use backdrop-blur-xl with a translucent background (light/dark adaptive), and absolutely contain all requested links plus the sun/moon toggle.
For the animated flowchart, use Framer Motion or an SVG animation library to visually depict the API scraping -> delivery -> job board flow. Do not use generic static images.
For the stacked jobs card section (10 newly added companies), use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered stacking or vertical cascade layout.
Ensure the right-to-left logo carousel uses 'react-fast-marquee' or pure CSS infinite scroll with the provided logos.
Always enforce 'data-testid' on interactive elements per the testing rules.
Implement a robust Dark/Light toggle implementation using Tailwind's 'dark:' variant class system.
